roles.title: Finance & Accounting Internship
requirements: Commerce, Finance, or Accounting students (or recent grads)
Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets
Must Have understandings of accounts and statements
Curious, detail-oriented, and ready to learn
responsibilities: Help us keep our books clean and accurate
Work on Performa accounting and financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow)
Assist with budgeting, expense tracking, and invoice checks
Support in fundraising preparations — real exposure to how startups raise money!
Coordinate with our CA firm on audits and compliance
Help in creating Investment Documents (Pitch Deck)
